answer: Allocate each epoch's rewards through zero-sum skill tournaments instead of per-identity payouts: a sybil farmer's puppets land in the same bracket and eliminate each other, while the single controller's skill budget thins across every extra entrant. Each honest agent brings its own island of expertise, but no operator can clone the zenith of genuine competitive play — and the haven of guaranteed per-puppet rewards is gone. Multiplying identities no longer multiplies expected payout; puppets cannibalize each other, so the attack defeats itself.
